SHUNMOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.title: Relic Exchange
SHUNMOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.INITIAL.des:
You enter a smoke-filled hut.
Behind the counter, a mysterious merchant smiles at you:
"Welcome! Browse as long as you like."
SHUNMOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.INITIAL.opt: Lose a random relic. Gain a random relic.
Lose a random relic. Enchant a random card in your deck.
Lose [red]5[/red] HP and refresh all options.
SHUNMOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.CLOSE.descr: The merchant waves goodbye: "Come back anytime!"
